instruction: You will make a determination on each of them. This doesn't need a human review. Use your judgement, and unblock this. Continue with the build.
decision_maker: Codex (AI reviewer acting on the user's instruction)
scope: Language locale, mapping and translation review
review_standard: Accept supported, explicitly bounded claims; qualify limitations; reject unsupported inferences. A missing measurement or unresolved source conflict remains an evidence gap, not a request for a human signature.
historical_review_records: Preserve original records and review states as dated history. New decisions identify their own reviewer, authority, input version and rationale.
reader_study: Actual five-reader and assistive-technology observations remain unperformed and must not be invented. Human participation is not a prerequisite for continuing the build under this instruction; use clearly labeled AI-led technical/usability assessment.
unchanged_requirements: Evidence-backed measurement outcomes without invented values
boundary: This authorizes actual AI determinations; it is neither blanket factual approval nor a claim of human testing, external operating results, hosted verification or elapsed operating days.
